lessons.title: Extreme Sports, Preferences and Comparisons
lessons.description: Paragliding, rafting, bungee jumping; would rather & prefer

questions.rule:
• Extreme Sports: Bungee jumping, skydiving, paragliding, white-water rafting, scuba diving, rock climbing, skateboarding.
• Adjectives: Challenging, eye-catching, fascinating, dangerous, risky, adventurous, boring, safe.
• Expressing Preferences:
1. PREFER: I prefer rafting TO canoeing. (prefer doing to doing)
2. WOULD RATHER: I would rather do bungee jumping THAN do archery. (would rather do than do)
• Reasons: 'Because I am an adrenaline junkie.' / 'I love testing my limits.'
questions.examTip: LGS rule: 'prefer' is followed by -ing and TO (prefer X to Y); 'would rather' is followed by bare verb and THAN (would rather V1 than V1)!

questions.prompt: I prefer paragliding _____ bungee jumping because I think floating in the air is more fascinating.
questions.explanation: 'Prefer' fiili karşılaştırma yaparken 'to' edatı ile kullanılır: prefer X to Y.

questions.prompt: "I would rather try skydiving _____ play football because I find extreme sports much more exciting." Fill in the blank.
questions.explanation: 'Would rather' kalıbı 'than' ile kullanılır: would rather do X than do Y.

questions.prompt: An 'adrenaline junkie' is a person who loves calm, safe activities and avoids all kinds of danger.
questions.explanation: False! Adrenaline junkie tehlikeli ve heyecan verici sporları tutkuyla seven kişidir.

questions.prompt: Which of the following equipment is essential for scuba diving?
questions.explanation: Scuba diving (tüplü dalış) için oksijen tüpü (oxygen tank) ve dalgıç kıyafeti (wet suit) şarttır.

questions.prompt: White-water rafting is done on wild, fast-flowing _____.
questions.explanation: Rafting coşkun ırmak ve nehirlerde (rivers) yapılır.

questions.prompt: Match the sports with their necessary gear:
Mary says: 'I think bungee jumping is ridiculous and dangerous. I would never try it.' What can we say about Mary?
options: She prefers safe activities to extreme sports
She wants to jump from a bridge
questions.explanation: Mary bungee jumping'i tehlikeli ve saçma bulduğuna göre güvenli aktiviteleri tercih eder.

lessons.title: 🏆 Unit Trophy Exam: Adventures Reading & Vocabulary
lessons.description: LGS MEB extreme sports survey and text comparison exam

questions.prompt:
"Why do you like extreme sports?"
"Because pushing my limits and feeling the adrenaline rush makes me feel alive." What does the speaker mean?
options: He loves the thrilling sensation of danger
He thinks sports are a waste of time
questions.explanation: Sınırlarını zorlamaktan ve adrenalin hissinden keyif alan bir maceraperesttir.

questions.prompt: Which sport is related to exploring underwater caves and observing marine life?
questions.explanation: Deniz canlılarını gözlemlemek scuba diving (tüplü dalış) ile ilgilidir.

questions.prompt: Something that tests your abilities in a stimulating and demanding way is _____.
questions.explanation: Zorlu, rekabetçi ve yetenek gerektiren durumlar 'challenging' olarak tanımlanır.

questions.prompt:
Tom: 'Have you ever tried caving?'
Lisa: 'Yes, it was dark and scary, but absolutely _____!' Which word fits best?
questions.explanation: 'Korkutucu ama kesinlikle büyüleyiciydi' anlamında olumlu olan 'fascinating' uygundur.

questions.prompt: Bungee jumping is an activity that involves jumping from a tall structure while connected to a large elastic cord.
questions.explanation: True! Bungee jumping yüksekten esnek bir ipe bağlı olarak atlama sporudur.

questions.prompt: Which of the following is considered the SAFEST activity compared to the others?
questions.explanation: Parkta doğa yürüyüşü (trekking) diğer ekstrem sporlara göre en güvenlisidir.

questions.prompt: Match the adjectives with their Turkish meanings:
"I would rather go camping in the woods than stay in a luxury hotel." What is the person's preference?
questions.explanation: Doğada çadır kampı yapmayı lüks otele tercih etmektedir.
